regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow (4 of 17 themes eligible) and concentrated in Banks as a single crowded leader with breadth but mean-revert hurst (coincident, not predictive). The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps true), so the state justifies staying in eligible, trend-healthy themes while remaining humble about the crowded leader — but no ETF proxies exist for most scorable HK themes, limiting falsifiability. Note the track record is extremely strong (48 calls, 95.8% directional accuracy), which supports slightly higher conviction, though small-sample discipline still warrants defaulting low-to-medium.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) closes the score margin against Banks to under 0.15 AND its durability_bar stays above 0.70 — that combination would suggest a confirmed leadership handoff away from the crowded Banks theme (retire the watch if margin widens past 0.45 or Energy's hurst flips to mean-revert).

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the challenger to Banks, eligible with the highest durability_bar (0.75) and a trend hurst tag (the staying-power leg), plus healthy breadth (0.70) and no crowding (z=0.41). It is the strongest non-crowded, trend-confirmed theme in an otherwise narrow eligible set.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is recent and its score gap to Banks is wide (0.325 margin); the broad momentum rank-IC is ~0, so this is a durability/focus judgment, not a forecast, and Energy could stall against a crowded, high-breadth Banks leader.

falsifier.text: Energy's durability_bar drops below 0.55 or its hurst_tag flips to mean-revert before the check-by date.

falsifier.text: Banks' breadth holds above 0.80 and crowding_z rises above 1.3 while remaining eligible and rank 1 — i.e., the leader does NOT roll over.
